headline: Executive order aims to expand the use of a hiring path that lets federal agencies hire military spouses without the usual competition.
what_it_does: This order deals with an existing rule that lets federal agencies hire spouses of military members without putting them through the standard competitive hiring process. Based on its title, the order is meant to strengthen or increase the use of that hiring path across the federal government. No official summary was provided, so the specific steps it requires are not described here.

who_it_affects.group: Spouses of military service members seeking federal jobs
who_it_affects.how: They may find it easier to be hired into federal civil service jobs through the noncompetitive appointment path.

who_it_affects.group: Federal agencies and their hiring offices
who_it_affects.how: They are directed to make greater use of the noncompetitive hiring option for military spouses.

when_it_takes_effect: Signed May 9, 2018; executive orders generally take effect when signed unless they say otherwise.
